title: Fleet UE traffic
description: NetFlow from the TAG IPsec headends via Akvorado (raw flows, 7-day retention).

list.name: machine
list.label: Machine
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT SrcNetTenant FROM flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback') AND SrcNetTenant != '' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: machines seen in the last day

panels.title: UE traffic (decrypted)
panels.description: Decrypted traffic to and from UE LANs and loopbacks, both directions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Bytes) AS bytes FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))

panels.title: Active UEs
panels.description: UEs with decrypted traffic in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(if(FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '')))) AS ues FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote})) AND if(FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''))) != ''

panels.title: Machines trying the internet
panels.description: UEs whose LAN sent traffic to a public (non-private) address.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''))) AS ues FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND (NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '10.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '172.16.0.0/12') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '192.168.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '100.64.0.0/10') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '127.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '169.254.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '224.0.0.0/4')) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))

panels.title: ...with no reply
panels.description: UEs that sent to public addresses but got nothing back from any public address.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS ues FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')) AS ue FROM flows
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND (NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '10.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '172.16.0.0/12') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '192.168.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '100.64.0.0/10') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '127.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '169.254.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '224.0.0.0/4')) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote})))
WHERE ue NOT IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '')) FROM flows
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND (NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '10.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '172.16.0.0/12') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '192.168.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '100.64.0.0/10') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '127.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '169.254.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '224.0.0.0/4')) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote})))

panels.title: UEs carrying data via standby TAG
panels.description: OC4-TAG01 is primary; decrypted traffic through OC3-TAG01 means the UE has failed over.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(if(FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '')))) AS ues FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ExporterSite = 'oc3' AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))

panels.title: Top UEs
panels.description: Decrypted traffic per UE. Machine = register asset, or the name cellwatch found on the UE LAN.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''))) AS UE, any(if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant)) AS Machine,
       sumIf(Bytes, FlowDirection = 'egress') AS `From UE`,
       sumIf(Bytes, FlowDirection = 'ingress') AS `To UE`,
       sum(Bytes) AS Total, count() AS Flows,
       uniqExactIf(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), FlowDirection = 'egress') AS Destinations
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote})) AND if(FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''))) != ''
GROUP BY UE ORDER BY Total DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Traffic by machine (top 10)
panels.description: Decrypted traffic, both directions, for the 10 busiest machines (UE name when the machine is unknown).

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (
  SELECT if(if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) != '', if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant), if(FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '')))) AS who FROM flows
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
  GROUP BY who ORDER BY sum(Bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, if(if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) != '', if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant), if(FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '')))) AS machine, sum(Bytes) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote})) AND if(if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) != '', if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant), if(FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '')))) IN (SELECT who FROM top)
GROUP BY time, machine ORDER BY time

panels.title: Where UEs send traffic
panels.description: UE LAN / loopback -> destination, decrypted. UEs = how many UEs sent to it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS Destination, any(DstNetName) AS Label, multiIf(Proto = 6, 'TCP', Proto = 17, 'UDP', Proto = 1, 'ICMP', Proto = 50, 'ESP', toString(Proto)) AS Protocol,
       DstPort AS Port, uniqExact(SrcNetName) AS UEs, sum(Bytes) AS Bytes, count() AS Flows
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
GROUP BY Destination, Protocol, Port ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Traffic by service
panels.description: UE -> destination traffic by protocol/destination port.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(multiIf(Proto = 6, 'TCP', Proto = 17, 'UDP', Proto = 1, 'ICMP', Proto = 50, 'ESP', toString(Proto)), if(DstPort > 0, concat('/', toString(DstPort)), '')) AS service,
       sum(Bytes) AS bytes
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
GROUP BY service ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Who sends traffic to UEs
panels.description: Source -> UE LAN / loopback, decrypted (pollers, servers, ...).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS Source, any(SrcNetName) AS Label, multiIf(Proto = 6, 'TCP', Proto = 17, 'UDP', Proto = 1, 'ICMP', Proto = 50, 'ESP', toString(Proto)) AS Protocol,
       SrcPort AS Port, uniqExact(DstNetName) AS UEs, sum(Bytes) AS Bytes
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
GROUP BY Source, Protocol, Port ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Machines reaching public addresses
panels.description: UE LAN -> public address (anything outside 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 100.64/10, multicast), matched with the replies (same address and port, the other way). Answered = No: nothing came back (for TCP that means only connection attempts, ~60-byte SYNs).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.UE AS UE, o.Machine AS Machine, o.Destination AS Destination, o.Protocol AS Protocol,
       o.Port AS Port, o.pkts AS `Packets out`, r.pkts AS `Packets back`,
       if(r.pkts > 0, 'Yes', 'No') AS Answered,
       o.bytes AS `Bytes out`, r.bytes AS `Bytes back`, o.last AS `Last sent`
FROM (
  SELECT if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')) AS UE, any(SrcNetTenant) AS Machine, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS Destination,
         multiIf(Proto = 6, 'TCP', Proto = 17, 'UDP', Proto = 1, 'ICMP', Proto = 50, 'ESP', toString(Proto)) AS Protocol, DstPort AS Port, sum(Packets) AS pkts, sum(Bytes) AS bytes,
         max(TimeReceived) AS last
  FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND (NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '10.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '172.16.0.0/12') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '192.168.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '100.64.0.0/10') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '127.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '169.254.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '224.0.0.0/4')) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
  GROUP BY UE, Destination, Protocol, Port) AS o
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', '')) AS UE, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS Destination, multiIf(Proto = 6, 'TCP', Proto = 17, 'UDP', Proto = 1, 'ICMP', Proto = 50, 'ESP', toString(Proto)) AS Protocol,
         SrcPort AS Port, sum(Packets) AS pkts, sum(Bytes) AS bytes
  FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND (NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '10.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '172.16.0.0/12') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '192.168.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '100.64.0.0/10') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '127.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '169.254.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '224.0.0.0/4')) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
  GROUP BY UE, Destination, Protocol, Port) AS r
  ON o.UE = r.UE AND o.Destination = r.Destination AND o.Protocol = r.Protocol AND o.Port = r.Port
ORDER BY `Bytes out` DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Internet: sent vs replies
panels.description: All UE traffic to public addresses, and all traffic back from them. Replies at zero means no UE is getting answers from the internet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
       sumIf(Bytes, (FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND (NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '10.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '172.16.0.0/12') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '192.168.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '100.64.0.0/10') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '127.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '169.254.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '224.0.0.0/4'))) * 8 / $__interval_s AS `Sent to internet`,
       sumIf(Bytes, (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) AND (NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '10.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '172.16.0.0/12') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '192.168.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '100.64.0.0/10') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '127.0.0.0/8') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '169.254.0.0/16') AND NOT isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), '224.0.0.0/4'))) * 8 / $__interval_s AS `Replies from internet`
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tunnels per UE
panels.description: Tunnel = encrypted ESP/IKE from the UE's cellular address to each TAG (standby still sees keepalives). Data = decrypted traffic through that TAG. UEs not on OC4, or with no data, are listed first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if((FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND SrcNetRole = 'ue-cellular' AND DstNetRole = 'vpn-headend') OR FlowDirection = 'egress', if(SrcNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), SrcNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), if(DstNetName NOT IN ('', 'ue-lan', 'ue-loopback', 'ue-cellular'), DstNetName, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(DstAddr), '::ffff:', ''))) AS UE,
       any(if((FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND SrcNetRole = 'ue-cellular' AND DstNetRole = 'vpn-headend') OR FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant)) AS Machine,
       sumIf(Bytes, (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND SrcNetRole = 'ue-cellular' AND DstNetRole = 'vpn-headend') AND ExporterSite = 'oc4') AS `Tunnel OC4`, sumIf(Bytes, ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ExporterSite = 'oc4') AS `Data OC4`, sumIf(Bytes, (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND SrcNetRole = 'ue-cellular' AND DstNetRole = 'vpn-headend') AND ExporterSite = 'oc3') AS `Tunnel OC3`, sumIf(Bytes, ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback'))) AND ExporterSite = 'oc3') AS `Data OC3`,
       multiIf(`Data OC3` > `Data OC4`, 'OC3 (standby)', `Data OC4` > 0, 'OC4',
               `Tunnel OC4` > `Tunnel OC3`, 'OC4 (no data)', 'OC3 (no data)') AS `Carried by`,
       maxIf(TimeReceived, (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND SrcNetRole = 'ue-cellular' AND DstNetRole = 'vpn-headend')) AS `Last tunnel packet`
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND ((FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND SrcNetRole = 'ue-cellular' AND DstNetRole = 'vpn-headend') OR ((FlowDirection = 'egress' AND SrcNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')) OR (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND DstNetRole IN ('ue-lan', 'ue-loopback')))) AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
GROUP BY UE HAVING UE != ''
ORDER BY (`Carried by` != 'OC4') DESC, `Data OC4` + `Data OC3` ASC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Encrypted tunnel traffic by TAG
panels.description: ESP/IKE from UEs to each TAG. A shift from OC4 to OC3 = UEs failing over.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, upper(ExporterSite) AS tag, sum(Bytes) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps
FROM flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ExporterName LIKE '%-TAG%' AND (FlowDirection = 'ingress' AND SrcNetRole = 'ue-cellular' AND DstNetRole = 'vpn-headend') AND ('__all' IN (${machine:singlequote}) OR if(FlowDirection = 'egress', SrcNetTenant, DstNetTenant) IN (${machine:singlequote}))
GROUP BY time, tag ORDER BY time
